assessment: This work provides interesting insight into and hypotheses about the ecological roles of fluorescent proteins (like GFP) that many scientists use as tools for their experiments, but whose natural roles are little understood. The work provides evidence that they modify the light environment available to the organism (here a coral and its symbionts) to allow for photosynthesis even under low light conditions. Thus, the work provides an interesting mixture of insight to scientists of other disciplines to understand what they are working with and to ecologists/marine biologists to better understand light usage in the oceans. The paper is very well written.
